name: Tachikawa Haruna
source: Tachikawa Haruna is a human girl who is one of Kururu’s close friends. She has a gentle, soft-spoken presence and gives off a calm, soothing atmosphere. Although she tends to be shy and not very assertive, she is kind and considerate toward others. Like Kururu, she is a member of the school’s Literature Club, where her quiet personality fits in well.
